meta.name: claude-code-usage
meta.description: Check Claude Code OAuth usage limits (session & weekly quotas). Use when user asks about Claude Code usage, remaining limits, rate limits, or how much Claude usage they have left. Includes automated session refresh reminders and reset detection monitoring.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询 Claude Code 使用配额与剩余限制
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Claude Code 并需要跟踪 OAuth 使用量
copy.tagline_en: Check Claude Code OAuth usage limits and remaining quotas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Claude Code and need to track OAuth usage

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以检查你的 Claude Code OAuth 使用限额，包括会话（5小时）和每周（7天）的剩余量，并显示进度条和重置时间。
howto.when: 当你询问 Claude Code 的使用情况、剩余限额、速率限制或还有多少使用量时触发。

say.text: 检查我的 Claude Code 使用限额
say.note: 显示当前会话和每周使用百分比及重置时间。

say.text: 我的 Claude Code 会话还剩多少？
say.note: 显示会话限额的剩余时间和使用率。

say.text: 刷新使用数据并显示 JSON
say.note: 强制从 API 获取最新数据并以 JSON 格式输出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can check your Claude Code OAuth usage limits, including session (5-hour) and weekly (7-day) remaining quotas, and display progress bars and reset times.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about Claude Code usage, remaining limits, rate limits, or how much Claude usage you have left.

say_en.text: Check my Claude Code usage limits
say_en.note: Shows current session and weekly usage percentages and reset times.

say_en.text: How much of my Claude Code session is left?
say_en.note: Shows session limit remaining time and usage rate.

say_en.text: Refresh usage data and show JSON
say_en.note: Forces a fresh API request and outputs in JSON format.
